fusions.name: Grapple Swoop
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy up to 7 tiles away and swoops you to it along the chain, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Flight of Hooks
fusions.desc: Flicks 2 light hooks out to 9 tiles, each dealing 3 damage, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: To the High Perch
fusions.desc: Hooks a point up to 7 tiles away and pulls you to it at once. You also gain 10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Swung Momentum
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
